body: Gibraltar is a British Overseas Territory on the Iberian Peninsula, bordering Spain. It counts as the United Kingdom for country streaks.
All coverage is Generation 3 and features a unique long antenna with a silver tip, known as the 'Gibraltar antenna'. This antenna is also found in some non-bordering areas of Spain.
The territory's most famous feature is the Rock of Gibraltar, a massive limestone mountain with exposed white rocks and a distinctive shape that dominates the landscape.
Like the UK, Gibraltar uses yellow rear licence plates on vehicles.
Unlike the UK, Gibraltar drives on the right side of the road.
The main language is English, which can be a key clue in a Mediterranean setting, but be aware that Malta also uses English.
Urban areas are dense with Mediterranean-style buildings featuring pastel colours and louvered window shutters, often painted green, blue, or brown.
All coverage was filmed in December, so you will often see Christmas decorations.
Gibraltar is the only place in Europe where you can find wild monkeys, specifically the Barbary macaque.
Near the southern tip, you can see the minarets of the Ibrahim-al-Ibrahim Mosque, the southernmost mosque in continental Europe.
